text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, I suppose I do like it, but... 
What brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'll ask Big Sis to do it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, hold on a sec! Just what are you 
planning on ordering?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You ought to eat something delicious on 
your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, today's your birthday, ain't it? 
Then I'll treat ya to the most delicious 
food I know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"! Ahahaha, so that's why you went with 
Hayahide's curry! I see. You barely 
explained anything, but you sure have your 
cute moments."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...If you don't want it, that's fine with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I didn't say that. Well then, let's 
go ask your big sis to make us some curry.
